show: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
strategy: Open with the early, unmistakable premise (jilted bride and a scarred stranger's proposal), because viewers land on episode 1 and E1-E3 promos pay off fastest. Then rotate the angles (cruel sister, protector romance, ring mystery, villain menace, slow-burn romance, revenge tease) so that no two wedding-scene promos run back to back. Late-episode material is held to teases that hint at the Duke reveal without spoiling it.

weak.problem: Same branding-iron scene as E31-P1. Posting both splits the audience, so keep only E31.
Reuses the E12 crawl hook. Its lower auto score (0.69) does not justify a second slot for the same scene.
Shows the scarred man proclaimed the rightful Duke, which spoils the show's central reveal 42 episodes early.
Also reveals the Duke's identity and needs 43 episodes of patience. It is spoiler-heavy and weak for acquisition.
Lowest stand-alone score (6): a stranger cannot tell who the poisoned woman is or why Juliana is disguised.
Weakest cliffhanger (6): it ends on begging with no clear unresolved threat.
Overlaps X-01, which opens with the same 'Gerald?' hook and has a stronger cliff, so E01-P1 is redundant.
